name: Countries, Capitals & Currencies
summary: Global nations, their administrative capitals, national currencies, and regional blocs.
concept: Systematic index of sovereign nations and territorial capitals across Asia, Europe, Africa, Americas, and Oceania. Commonly examined pairings include Japan (Tokyo, Yen), Russia (Moscow, Ruble), South Korea (Seoul, Won), UK (London, Pound Sterling), China (Beijing, Renminbi/Yuan), Brazil (Brasília, Real), South Africa (Pretoria/Cape Town/Bloemfontein, Rand), and Australia (Canberra, Australian Dollar).

subtopics.name: Key Global Nations & Currencies
subtopics.summary: Major trading economies, G20 nations, and neighboring states.

facts.title: South Africa's Three Capital Cities
facts.content: South Africa has three official capitals: Pretoria (Executive/Administrative), Cape Town (Legislative), and Bloemfontein (Judicial).

facts.title: Eurozone Currency Area
facts.content: The Euro (€) is the official common currency utilized by 20 of the 27 European Union member states (Croatia joined as 20th member in Jan 2023).

mcqs.q: What is the capital city of Canada, situated on the south bank of the Ottawa River?

mcqs.q: What is the name of the national Parliament of Japan?
mcqs.questionText: What is the name of the national Parliament of Japan?

mcqs.exp: The National Diet (Kokkai) is Japan's bicameral legislature, composed of the House of Representatives and the House of Councillors.
mcqs.explanation: The National Diet (Kokkai) is Japan's bicameral legislature, composed of the House of Representatives and the House of Councillors.
mcqs.expHi: जापान की द्विसदनीय संसद को 'डाइट' (Diet / Kokkai) कहा जाता है। इसमें प्रतिनिधि सभा और पार्षद सभा शामिल हैं।
mcqs.explanationHi: जापान की द्विसदनीय संसद को 'डाइट' (Diet / Kokkai) कहा जाता है। इसमें प्रतिनिधि सभा और पार्षद सभा शामिल हैं।
